Están llegando diseños nuevos — sigue puntuando, tus puntos se guardan mientras dibujo.

The cast: six room bosses, corpus registerdescartado All six room bosses in one language, rebuilt against what the reference images do rather than what the manifest prose says: dot eyes, legs standing on the floor, one bold silhouette shape each (hair mass, open vest, headset, held ball, shopping bag, magnifier), flat saturated fills under a heavy black contour. 0★★★★★ 👍 👎 ✓

nuevo, no compite con nada

Round · six builds, not one build in six colours

The cast, told apart by silhouette

Four corrections applied. Bodies are rounded blobs rather than boxes, and so are the legs and shoes. The hat is gone from everyone except the Commander, whose headset is his signature, and the rest carry hair that follows the skull. Each figure has its own height, width and head size, so the silhouettes separate before the colour does. The CEO's vest is formal navy, which the user asked for and the corpus does not contain.

/first · Acid Rockstar

Tall and narrow. The only one whose hair carries the silhouette, spilling wider than the shoulders. Tinted lenses, yellow scarf, mic in the raised hand.

at room size

/build · Tech-Bro CEO

No headwear, short side-parted hair. Squarer shoulders than the rest because he is the formal one, and the vest is navy over a white shirt.

at room size

/land · Mission Commander

Short and stocky, the widest body of the six. The headset is the one piece of real headwear in the cast, and it is what names him.

at room size

/check · Scrum Oracle

The narrowest build, small round head under a bob. The ball hangs off the raised arm so it stays in the hand at any angle.

at room size

/kit · Token Influencer

Widest stance, big styled pink hair and no hat. The hero bag hangs from the near hand so it reads inside the silhouette.

at room size

/fix · Bug Doctor

Tallest and thinnest, long white coat over a lime collar. Magnifier raised with the bug caught inside the lens.

at room size
